readme_text:
# atlas-hub-inventory

Inventory tracker for the **Project Atlas** Lisbon distribution hub.

It records incoming pallets, shelf locations, and outgoing loads per delivery route. Warehouse leads will use it from January 2027, when the hub fit-out begins. **Maria Lopez** reviews the monthly stock-cost summary for the Atlas budget.
